entities.name: Kaito Shizuki
entities.description: A planeswalker who returns the emperor to Eiganjo, then goes to destroy Tameshi's compound and is captured in a trap.

entities.name: The Wanderer
entities.description: A planeswalker who is also the Emperor of Kamigawa, with an unstable spark stabilized for a time by the Reality Chip fused to her hand.

entities.name: Tamiyo
entities.description: A moonfolk planeswalker who helps Kaito and is captured by Tezzeret.

entities.name: Tezzeret
aliases: the man with the metal arm
entities.description: A pink-eyed planeswalker with a metal arm who controls technology, working with Phyrexia, and traps Kaito and Tamiyo.

entities.name: Jin-Gitaxias
entities.description: A chrome monster who runs experiments on kami and planeswalkers and is cleaved by the Wanderer's sword.

entities.name: Light-Paws
entities.description: A seven-tailed kitsune advisor who urges the emperor to stay in Eiganjo.

entities.name: Eiko Shizuki
entities.description: Kaito's sister, an Imperial who asks the emperor to bring Kaito home.

entities.name: Kyodai
entities.description: The guardian kami of Kamigawa whose bond with the emperor leaves her confused by the emperor's unstable spark.

entities.name: Tameshi
entities.description: Kaito's late friend, whose compound holds the lab.

entities.name: Risona
entities.description: A leader of the Asari Uprisers who is told of the emperor's return and marches on Eiganjo.

entities.name: Asari Uprisers
entities.description: Rebels from the snowy volcanic region who plan to attack the palace.

entities.name: Imperials
entities.description: The ruling court and samurai of Kamigawa who prepare to defend Eiganjo.

entities.name: Phyrexia
entities.description: An outside power that Tezzeret says needs more than kami; its research is being conducted in the lab.

entities.name: Undercity henchmen
entities.description: Hired Undercity fighters who ambush Kaito and Tamiyo.

entities.name: Reality Chip
entities.description: A thin chip with jellyfish-like wires that fuses to the emperor's hand, stabilizing her spark and giving her visions of the lab.

entities.name: Kami War
entities.description: An ancient war between the mortal and spirit realms now treated as legend.

entities.name: Eiganjo
entities.description: The Imperial city and palace where the emperor returns.

entities.name: Otawara
entities.description: The floating city where Tameshi's compound stands.

entities.name: Tameshi's compound
entities.description: The compound on Otawara containing the lab where kami are experimented on and the Reality Chip's machine.

entities.name: Kamigawa
entities.description: The plane on the brink of war.

events.summary: Kaito, Tamiyo, and the emperor arrive in the emperor's garden in Eiganjo, and the emperor enters Kyodai's temple.
events.quote: She turned for the porch, slid open the door to Kyodai's temple, and disappeared inside.

events.summary: Kaito and Tamiyo find Kyodai reunited with the emperor, both in pain from the emperor's unstable spark.
events.quote: "Your spark is still unstable. You cannot remain on Kamigawa without help."

events.summary: Tamiyo places the Reality Chip on the emperor's hand and it fuses to her flesh, stabilizing her for a time.
events.quote: the wires fused to her flesh like veins pulsing with energy.

events.summary: The emperor reveals she has visions of the lab and that Jin-Gitaxias told Risona and the Uprisers of her return, so they will attack the palace.
events.quote: They plan to attack the palace imminently.

events.summary: The emperor tells Kaito she heard of his search across the planes and nearly met him many times.
events.quote: "Sometimes I was only a step behind you.

events.summary: Light-Paws and Eiko arrive and bow to the emperor, who orders the court to prepare against the Uprisers.
events.quote: We must prepare our forces at once."

events.summary: Tamiyo urges destroying the Reality Chip, but Kaito objects and proposes destroying Tameshi's lab with Imperial detonators.
The emperor approves the plan to destroy the compound, and agrees to remain in Eiganjo.
events.quote: "I will remain here," she said at last.

events.summary: Kaito promises the emperor to free any captive kami before setting off the charge.
Kaito and Tamiyo return to Otawara and find the lab unlocked and the kami gone, their beds covered in metallic ash.
events.quote: The only evidence of a kami dematerializing.

events.summary: Tezzeret appears and tells them the experiments are about testing the connection between body and soul for Phyrexia, thanking them for bringing planeswalkers to the lab.
events.quote: And kami are much easier to come by than what Phyrexia really needs."

events.summary: Kaito and Tamiyo realize it was a trap and that the experiments are about planeswalkers, and the henchmen close in.
events.quote: It was a trap—and Kaito and Tamiyo had walked right into it.

events.summary: Tezzeret restrains Tamiyo with the lab's equipment and holds star-blades to Kaito's throat.
events.quote: a strip of metal equipment tore from the ceiling and wrapped itself around her hand like a monstrous restraint.

events.summary: Kaito throws a detonator at the machine room, but Tezzeret catches it and breaks it apart; Kaito is knocked unconscious.
events.quote: the detonator broke apart piece by piece, until it became nothing more than a pile of useless metal and microchips.

events.summary: The Wanderer has a vision of the ambush and decides to planeswalk into the compound, with Eiko encouraging her to save Kaito.
events.quote: "They were ambushed by Tezzeret and Jin-Gitaxias."

events.summary: Using her bond with Kyodai to stabilize her spark, the Wanderer planeswalks to Tameshi's compound.
events.quote: the Wanderer planeswalked out of Eiganjo and into Tameshi's compound with a flash of light.

events.summary: The Wanderer cleaves Jin-Gitaxias with her sword and frees Kaito and Tamiyo from the surgical tables.
events.quote: The Wanderer brought her sword down like a blow from the heavens and cleaved Jin-Gitaxias from his neck to his chest.

relations.quote: Jin-Gitaxias appeared from the shadows, moving beside Tezzeret like a looming nightmare.
It's because of our bond—the uncertainty of my spark affects her a great deal."

work together to destroy the lab

relations.quote: "I wouldn't do that. Not if you want your friend to live,"
